source.title: Is Mumbai 3.0 the Next Boom?
source.description:
Maharashtra is targeting a $1 trillion economy by 2030. Its GDP is already neck-and-neck with the UAE’s GDP, but reaching the next milestone will require new growth centres beyond Mumbai & Pune.

With a long-term vision, Mumbai 3.0 will definitely be one of those growth centres. 

I had an insightful conversation about this with Jatin Agarwal of Eltria, who brings over 20 years of experience in real estate and land development.

pack.topic: Evaluating Multi-Sector Infrastructure Convergence for Property Investment
pack.source_script_insight: Real estate appreciation does not rely on a single infrastructure trigger, but on the simultaneous, interconnected convergence of multiple economic sectors forming a complete ecosystem.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Applying the multi-sector economic convergence principle to evaluating emerging growth corridors around Coimbatore without fabricating local project claims.
pack.visual_strategy: Using tight, eye-level and controlled-motion macro footage of urban connectivity, logistics transit points, and commercial clusters in Coimbatore to demonstrate multi-sector convergence, entirely avoiding generic aerial land panning or happy family tropes.
pack.core_takeaway: True land value growth stems from complete economic ecosystem convergence, not isolated infrastructure announcements.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
CRITICAL OUTPUT LOCK: Produce a strictly vertical 9:16 portrait video, exactly 10 seconds in duration. This must be 100% photorealistic, physical-world footage shot with a professional mirrorless camera in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Absolutely no animation, no 2D/3D graphics, no CGI, no cartoon or explainer styles, no aerial drone filler, no happy family tropes, and no generic construction house sequences.

SUBJECT AND EVIDENCE FOCUS: The subject is 'infrastructure impact' demonstrating multi-sector convergence. Source evidence points: 1) Appreciation driven by multi-sector convergence rather than single project hype; 2) Self-sustaining economic ecosystem replacing speculative real estate pockets; 3) Integration of economic pillars including logistics, transport, and commercial zones; 4) Macro economic scale matching regional growth. The setting is Coimbatore ONLY.

EXACT 7-SHOT BREAKDOWN (0.0s to 10.0s):
- Shot 1 (0.0s - 1.3s): Close-up shot of a dusty road junction sign in an outer Coimbatore corridor under harsh midday sun, showing converging tarmac paths with moderate truck traffic. Text overlay: ஒற்றை திட்டம்? VO: ஒற்றை திட்டத்தை
- Shot 2 (1.3s - 2.8s): Medium-angle shot of a busy suburban industrial supply warehouse loading dock in Coimbatore with workers organizing logistics crates. Text overlay: சங்கமிக்கும் இடம் VO: நம்பி முதலீடு
- Shot 3 (2.8s - 4.3s): Stable side-angle shot of multi-axle freight trucks moving steadily along a major four-lane Coimbatore bypass under realistic natural overcast lighting. Text overlay: பல்வேறு துறைகள் VO: செய்யாதீர்கள். பல
- Shot 4 (4.3s - 5.8s): Eye-level shot of professionals entering a modern glass-façade IT park lobby in Peelamedu, Coimbatore, with authentic reflections. Text overlay: உண்மையான வளர்ச்சி VO: துறைகள் சங்கமிக்கும்
- Shot 5 (5.8s - 7.2s): Street-level perspective of a bustling college corridor perimeter wall with students walking past academic buildings in suburban Coimbatore. Text overlay: சரியான மதிப்பீடு VO: இடமே உண்மையான
- Shot 6 (7.2s - 8.6s): Stable medium shot of a functioning commercial hub facade with active retail foot traffic along a paved Coimbatore avenue. Text overlay: சுழற்சி முறை VO: வளர்ச்சி. ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ
- Shot 7 (8.6s - 10.0s): Clean, sharp eye-level shot of a detailed property assessment file and map spread across a wooden desk under soft indoor light, with subtle OliveTree Investors text overlay. Text overlay: OliveTree Investors VO: இன்வெஸ்டர்ஸ்

CAMERA AND REALISM REQUIREMENTS: Natural sunlight, authentic material textures, realistic shadows and perspective, stable geometry, no digital distortion, no fake landmarks, no religious symbols, native 9:16 composition throughout.
